column2: [intro]
My closet's a total mess,
With socks and leftovers, no less,
But I always find my clothes,
In this chaos that makes people pose.
I'm messy, that’s no secret,
In my world, order’s not perfect,
I mix it all, I’m quite the nut,
Disorder is my daily rut.
In my kitchen, pots pile high,
But I whip up recipes that never lie,
Mixed flavors burst with delight,
And my friends love it, what a sight.
I’m a perfectionist, wanting it right,
But I’m messy, it’s my way of life,
I muddle things up, it makes me laugh,
An artist of chaos, that’s my craft.
[ solo ]
So if you’re messy and a bit of a perfectionist too,
Come dance with me, in this optimistic view,
For disorder and order can coexist,
In a world where madness reigns, come and enlist!
[outro]
